propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of unreachable history in tickets store must be reclaimed via length-aware git fast-export filter and fast-import, followed by repack and gc to release disk bytes.
Filtered tickets pack size exceeded CI verification limit (131,431 KiB > 131,072 KiB limit); repack maintenance is required to reduce pack below 128 MiB for stale-based changes.
History rewrite must preserve tree, commit count, and merge count; remove .bridge_state.bak-retarget history; and maintain identity equivalence of (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets.
Publication requires exact force-with-lease, verified off-repo bundles before and after repair, and proof that old tip is not reachable in the published remote.
Deterministic first post-rewrite write must occur with opportunistic enrichment disabled (REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN=off) and be the sole commit in the measurement interval to establish clean baseline.
